changesets.title: Creator Reactivation Campaign (3-Tier)
changesets.hypothesis: 91.2% creator dormancy (228 of 250 inactive >30d) can be reduced to ~80% through structured 3-tier reactivation: personal outreach (top 20), email sequence (next 50), automated (rest). Target: 10% reactivation = 23 new active creators.
changesets.expected_impact: If 23 creators reactivated at avg $445/creator/month (CLEETUS benchmark), adds ~$10K/month creator revenue. Conservative estimate: $3-5K/month.
changesets.measurement_plan: Track active creator count, creator revenue, and conversion rate at 14d and 30d post-outreach. Baseline: 22 active, $9.8K revenue, 2.81% commission rate.
